transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because my in-laws have been working against me. They use the altar and the parish committee to push me out, like they want everyone to forget everything I’ve done for this family.
Have you ever heard voices or people talking when there was no one around?

Yes. On several nights I heard my late mother’s voice telling me where to put the marigolds and candles. And once I saw her standing by the kitchen doorway, but my husband said there was nobody there.
How has your mood been over the past few weeks?
The past few weeks… after all that energy left me, I wake up with this heavy sadness. It feels like there’s no joy left in my house, or in me.
During that time when you had all that energy, did you find you needed much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?
At first, yes. I’d sleep maybe a couple of hours and get up feeling like I had to make lists. But now I’m awake before dawn worrying, and I never feel rested.
Did you hear your mother's voice or feel your in-laws were working against you at times when your mood was completely normal?

No. Those things only happened when I was barely sleeping and rushing around, feeling like I had this special duty with the altar. When my mood dropped, I was sad and guilty, but I wasn’t hearing my mother or seeing her anymore.
